judge.rationale: The candidate completely failed to make the actual code change in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block, leaving that item unchecked even in its own `.lore/dod.md`. Because the bug remains unfixed, the newly added test in `src/orchestration/beforeSession-error.acceptance.test.ts` will fail when `npm test` is run, and the unused `MessageChunk` import in that file will also fail ESLint. Furthermore, the candidate created a separate test file instead of adding the test to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and its spec update omits the required explanation of what `afterSession` can assume about how much of the turn happened when `beforeSession` throws.
